New York: Richemont and Signet Jewelers are in talks to join the consortium bidding for De Beers, Bloomberg and Reuters reported, carried by JCK on 15 October.

Signet owns Kay, Zales and Jared. Richemont owns Cartier and Van Cleef & Arpels. Neither stake would necessarily be large — the report says participation isn't guaranteed and names no figure.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
